class Inventory {
    public array $stockMap = [];

    public function addItem(string $itemName, int $quantity): void {
        // increase the stock for this item
        $current = $this->stockMap[$itemName] ?? 0;
        $this->stockMap[$itemName] = $current + $quantity;
    }

    public function removeItem(string $itemName, int $quantity): bool {
        $current = $this->stockMap[$itemName] ?? 0;
